title: CFA4 AI host report
description: What the CFA4 host reports about AI jobs and implementation choice to its own UI, CLI, control channel and MCP. Version 4 (2026-11-13: time estimates as ranges, outlook, schedule, class, user priority and execution path; 2026-11-08: CFA4 has no paid part, no limit_reached code and no watermark prediction; 2026-11-07: scheduled and paused states). Not part of the worker protocol: workers never send or receive these.

capability.description: Functional type from the manifest: AI-nnn or AU-nnn.

state.description: Job lifecycle. succeeded, failed and cancelled are final; blocked waits for the user (model, licence, hardware); scheduled waits for its start time; paused has saved its checkpoint, released its resources and can resume.

range.description: Version 4. A duration as a range, never one promised number: min_s <= max_s.

estimate.description: Version 4. How long the run takes, with how sure the host is. medium: the path was measured under this machine's run-minspec.sh profile; low: under another profile or an unknown one.

outlook.description: Version 4. What the user is told before starting: normal; slower (above the user's slower threshold); very_long (above the user's very-long threshold, offered, never refused); not_executable_now (no validated path fits this machine now, with the reasons in failed or blocked). The thresholds are user settings; the host applies them to the estimate's max_s.

class.description: Version 4. System class, ordered interactive (P0), final_render (R), background (P1), speculative (P2).

priority.description: Version 4. The user's priority; orders jobs within one class.

schedule.description: Version 4. How the job starts. now: at once, the user is told if it has to wait; when_resources: whenever the machine has room, silently; at: at a time, the user is told if it has to wait; at_with_resources: from a time on, whenever there is room. The machine is never woken up. missed says what happens when the start time passed by more than the grace period (5 minutes): run_late starts it late, next_slot moves it to the next time in its time zone, ask_user leaves it scheduled with missed = true until the user decides.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the user scheduled in, e.g. Europe/Budapest; at stays UTC.

check.description: One condition the router or resource manager tested, and why it failed.

capability: no implementation of the type; language: segment language not covered; license: unknown code or dependencies licence, or a weights or dataset licence warning the user has not accepted yet; model: weights missing or hash mismatch; format: weight format not loadable at this gate; runtime: runtime or provider not installed; device: no suitable device (vendor, display GPU excluded); vram: not enough free VRAM; ram: not enough RAM; resolution: above the implementation's maximum.

need.description: What the implementation requires, e.g. "5800 MB".

have.description: What this machine offers, e.g. "4100 MB free on GPU 0".

jobStatus.description: A job's state after every transition, as stored in the durable job store.

impl.description: Absent until the router has chosen; required from loading on.

attempt.description: 1 for the first run, higher after a retry.

missed.description: Version 4. Only in state scheduled: the start time was missed and the rule is ask_user, so the user decides.

path.description: Version 4. The manifest execution path that runs or would run.

switched.description: Version 4. The path is not the reference path; the user is told, and a path that changes the result ran only with the user's approval.

elapsed_s.description: Version 4. Running time so far, without paused and waiting time.

remaining.description: Version 4. Only while running or paused: the time still needed.

blocked.description: Only in state blocked: every condition that keeps the job from starting.

watermarked.description: In state succeeded: the worker visibly marked the output (e.g. the AI-modified marking of the synthetic-face policy).

routeDecision.description: What would run for a request and why, answered without running anything. Every candidate implementation is listed with the conditions it failed.

job.description: Set when the decision was made for a job.

chosen.description: The implementation that would run, or null when none passes every check.

outlook.description: Version 4. The outlook of the chosen candidate; not_executable_now when chosen is null.

path.description: Version 4. The manifest execution path the estimate is for.

approval.description: Version 4. The path changes the result (its tolerance has automatic = false), so it runs only after the user approves it; never a silent quality drop.

min_s.description: Version 4: the run time as a range.

device.description: "cpu", or the PCI address or UUID of the GPU the resource manager would use.
